_comment: Player-facing server brief rendered by the homepage (frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx). The inputs live in eco-ops (configs/Configs/*.diff.json, mods/Mods, mods/Configs/SkillsRequirements.eco), but this page describes the world players join, so where the live server has drifted from eco-ops the live value wins (restarts). This file is a reviewed copy, so bump reviewedOn whenever it is re-checked. Cycle number, world size, meteor length, meteor state and the Eco version are deliberately absent: the homepage reads them from live status, and a second copy here is how the old Discord block went stale. Each mod carries its attribution (author, href, source), and source doubles as the reason when there is no public link. serverPlumbing and servicePlugins feed /mods only, never the homepage count.

steps: Open Eco, choose Join, and search the server browser for Eco via Sirens.
Join the Discord for announcements, trade, and help from other players.
Read the welcome message the first time you log in.

nextCycle: Cycle 15 opens to players on Friday 9 October at 7pm Pacific, on Eco 0.14. Seven cycle 14 mods are benched this cycle, listed on the Mods page.

gameplayNotes.title: Dinner parties
gameplayNotes.body: Three parties a day count toward the bonus. Spread them across time zones so everyone gets a seat, and remember prepared food stays fresh for 600 minutes.

gameplayNotes.title: Every skill pays claims
gameplayNotes.body: Learning any skill grants 5 claim papers and 0.25 claim stakes, so land grows with what you know.

gameplayNotes.title: Specialize on purpose
gameplayNotes.body: Specialties cannot be abandoned and skills cost 3x, so plan your path with the skill trees and talk to the town before you commit.

gameplayNotes.title: Paid items
gameplayNotes.body: Paid items are sold in stores and work without a blueprint.

gameplayNotes.title: Build high, not deep
gameplayNotes.body: Terrain and buildings reach 200 blocks, but deep ocean building is off. Shallows and beaches are wide, so the coasts are the frontier.
